name: REDROOM
source:
If you haunt the internet through endless nights, beware – an invitation to the Red Room may find you. Who sends it, and what horrors lie within? The only fact: no one who gets the message lives to tell the tale.

[From [url=https://mai-k.itch.io/redroom]Itch.io[/url]]
